data.summary: Investing.com -- CarMax shares came under fresh pressure after CFRA and Oppenheimer cut their ratings on the used-car retailer, after disappointing quarterly earnings, weakening sales trends, and execution missteps.Shares were down 2% in premarket trading on Friday.
